newsitem.title: UK: SPAIN, PORTUGAL GREEN RATES DEVALUE MONDAY-HGCA.
newsitem.headline: SPAIN, PORTUGAL GREEN RATES DEVALUE MONDAY-HGCA.

text.p: The green rates of the Spanish peseta and Portuguese escudo are to be devalued with effect from Monday, August 11, the UK's Home Grown Cereals Authority said.
The green Spanish peseta will be devalued to 167.153 per Ecu from the current rate of 167.111 and the green Portuguese escudo will be devalued to 200.321 per Ecu from 200.230.
Also on Monday, the UK green rate will enter the last of five confirmation periods ahead of a possible revaluation on August 21, the HGCA said.
Green rates are used by the European Union to convert amounts set in Ecus under its Common Agricultural Policy.
